title: Pipe chart: pipe lines up through structure spheres
description:
The pipe shaft now paints through the centers of the From/To structure spheres so the pipe and end caps line up cleanly — no more butting against the sphere rims.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe shaft aligns through the center of each structure sphere.
Structure spheres sit behind the pipe so the connection reads cleanly.
